title: gouldia parvifolia var. subpilosa
intro: Gouldia parvifolia var. subpilosa, commonly known as the 'Sub-pilose Small-leaved Gouldia', is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. It is a shrub native to New Caledonia, with potential health benefits attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gouldia parvifolia var. subpilosa include reducing inflammation and improving immune response, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
